title: lespedeza japonica var. albiflora
intro: Lespedeza japonica var. albiflora, commonly known as White Lespedeza, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of White Lespedeza include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and support respiratory health. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
